newsitem.title: ITALY: Gucci could consider Milan listing in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Gucci could consider Milan listing in 1997.

text.p: Italian luxury goods group Gucci could consider a stock market listing on the Milan bourse in 1997, the group's chairman and managing director Domenico De Sole said in an interview with financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore.
"1997 could be the year in which Gucci will take into consideration a listing on the Milan market," he said.
The company is already listed in New York and Amsterdam.
The paper added that the company is likely to record annual pretax profits in the year to end-January 1997 of above 300 billion lire and sales in advance of one trillion lire.

In November, the group announced sales in the first nine months of its financial year to end-October up 81.2 percent to $620.2 million, and in the third quarter (August-October) sales were up 69.1 percent to $230.2 million.
